steps.name: Crafting blood runes at zeah is an easy way to make around 600k gp /h
73 agi is needed for the shortcut
This assumes you followed the "Account start" tab untill line 83
Get 73 agi and full gracful (bring summer pies)
Get 77 rc via guardians of the rift minigame
buy the raiments of the eye outfit (1350 pearls = 630 searches on avg)
buy blood essences (you use around 0.66-0.76 bloodess per hour)
start crafting blood runes for 500-600k gp/h depending of afkness
Can start running ess to other or yourself
can start making other runes trough abyss
